title: SNO Milestones
excerpt: Mar 1990 -- Start of cavity excavation; May 1999 -- First neutrinos found; Nov 1999 -- Production data taking begins; May 2001 -- Start of 2nd phase (salt fill); Feb 2004 -- Start of 3rd phase (NCD detectors); Nov 2006 -- End of datataking for 3rd phase; May 2007 -- D2O drained from acrylic vessel.
